6ef2de91c7:
A special Fourze form fused with Meteor's power by the Fusion Switch.
He can use Meteor's abilities, such as the Meteor Galaxy.
d659756f91:
The form Fourze takes with the Fusion Switch and the Nadeshiko Switch.
Its finisher is the Rider Double Rocket Missile, firing the missiles on both arms.
51bdcb8471:
Ring-wielding wizard Haruto Soma transforms with the WizarDriver and Wizard Rings.
Flame Style is his basic form, holding the power of fire, which he can add to the many spells cast with his rings.
558f2e4c9c:
A special Wizard form, transformed with the Water Wizard Ring.
Strong in magic, it excels at spells that bewilder enemies.
4c37338077:
A special Wizard form, transformed with the Hurricane Wizard Ring.
With great speed and jumping, it excels at attacks from the air.
69227b16b6:
A special Wizard form, transformed with the Land Wizard Ring.
With great attack and defense, it excels at powerful attacks.
34f225f008:
Flame Style powered up by Wizardragon's power.
Wizardragon's head appears on his chest and breathes powerful flames.
8a76407281:
Water Style powered up by Wizardragon's power.
Wizardragon's tail, the Drago Tail, takes form, attacking with water and cold.
6de5c08b53:
Hurricane Style powered up by Wizardragon's power.
Wizardragon's wings, the Drago Wings, take form, attacking with wind and lightning.
8eedc219e0:
Land Style powered up by Wizardragon's power.
Wizardragon's claws take form on both arms, tearing any enemy apart.
ce143e9c7d:
A super form that brings out all of Wizardragon's power with the Drago Timer.
It can use the power of every element.
9b52bdee1a:
A special Wizard form, transformed with the Special Rush Wizard Ring.
The power of the fire element is greatly enhanced.
daaf2a2efc:
Wizard's strongest form, transformed with the Infinity Wizard Ring.
He strikes with the Axe Calibur at high speed, and his overwhelming defense repels enemy attacks.
7af9565210:
A form transformed with the Finish Strike Wizard Ring.
Haruto's own rising magic has turned his whole body gold.
38618cebd5:
Kouta Kazuraba, a former member of the dance team Team Gaim, becomes this Armored Rider.
Orange Arms, from the Orange Lockseed, is Gaim's basic form, dual-wielding the Musou Saber and Daidaimaru.
48deb36e01:
Gaim's form from the Pine Lockseed.
With great power and defense, it fights mainly with powerful Pine Iron moves.
a6539c2df9:
Gaim's form from the Ichigo Lockseed.
Excelling in speed, it uses Ichigo Kunai for unpredictable attacks.
dc61ae6183:
Gaim's powered-up form, using a Genesis Core on the Sengoku Driver and the Lemon Energy Lockseed.
It fights mainly at range with the Sonic Arrow.
5ed9b925b2:
Gaim's powered-up form, from the Kachidoki Lockseed given by DJ Sagara.
He attacks with the two flags on his back and cuts enemies with a greatsword combining the Hinawa Daidai DJ Gun and Musou Saber.
2697e459f0:
A large form from the Suika Lockseed.
It switches between Gyro Mode, Armor Mode and Ball Mode.
66f459682f:
Gaim's strongest form, from the Kiwami Lockseed.
Equal to the Overlords who rule Helheim Forest, he can use every Armored Rider's weapons.
74e77d544b:
Shinnosuke Tomari, a cop on cases from the "Heavy Acceleration" phenomenon, becomes this Rider.
Type Speed is Drive's basic form; swapping tires with Shift Cars gives him various powers.
09811dd8a3:
Drive's form from Shift Wild, which needs a burning passion to transform.
It makes the most of its power with mighty attacks.
6db103dfb9:
Drive's form from Shift Technic, which needs a cool head to transform.
With high processing power it attacks precisely and handles delicate work like bomb disposal.
d350395a2d:
Drive's powered-up form from Shift Dead Heat, made to counter Heart Roidmude's Dead Zone.
Very hard to control; if the meter hits the red zone, he goes berserk.
23f3dd532a:
Drive's super form from Shift Formula. It moves freely even in Super Heavy Acceleration, fighting faster than Type Speed.
Its finisher is Trailer Impact, fired from the Trailer Cannon.
5ca938b8d2:
Drive's strongest form, from Shift Tridoron.
Both Shinnosuke and Mr. Belt can control his body in battle, trading the lead as needed.
c30971328a:
Takeru Tenkuji, a young man who once lost his life, returned to this world with the power to transform.
But he must fight while collecting 15 Eyecons within 99 days.
431cd92733:
A special enhanced armor suit worn by Makoto Hikawa.
Its AI guides the wearer to ideal attacks, and the GX Launcher hits as hard as Agito's Rider Kick.
fb2fba209c:
Ren Akiyama contracted with the Mirror Monster Dark Wing to save his comatose lover.
His finisher Hishouzan turns his cape into a drill around the Wing Lancer and charges.
4b84c9a72a:
Knight's powered-up form from the Survive "Gale" card.
Its finisher, Shippudan, turns Darkraider into its bike form to ram enemies.
538d0f5de4:
Sakuya Tachibana transforms with the Ace of Diamonds: Rider System No. 1, built to seal the Undead.
A seasoned fighter, his Garren Rouser shots are highly accurate.
04232d4656:
Garren's powered-up form, using the Jack and Queen of Diamonds.
He spreads the wings on his back and snipes enemies from the air.
78938af58e:
Transformed by entering "913" in the Kaixa Phone and setting it in the Kaixa Driver. Mainly worn by Masato Kusaka.
Its finisher Gold Smash kicks a target marked by the Kaixa Pointer on his right leg.
322222bc57:
Kaixa's beloved Side Basshaa in Battle Mode.
It wipes out enemies with missiles of huge firepower from the cannons on its arms.
90c32b6583:
Faiz's beloved Autovajin, transformed into an autonomous combat form.
It acts on its own will, supporting Faiz in many situations.
ec9a83ffae:
Ibuki, a leading Oni of the head family, transforms with his Onteki.
He excels at range with the Ongekikan Reppu, carrying out his role in the head family.
33bce63a86:
The "God of Battle", transformed by Arata Kagami of the secret organization ZECT.
Masked Form is Gatack's first form; casting off changes it into Rider Form.
98170c07d4:
Gatack's second form, after Casting Off from Masked Form.
He fights with the Gatack Double Calibur drawn from his shoulders and super-speed Clock Up, like other Masked Rider Systems.
93ce8e0dc6:
Yuto Sakurai transforms with the Zeronos Belt and Zeronos Cards.
He fights with the Zerogasher, which changes between Saber Mode and Bowgun Mode.
2e10a4f039:
A special Zeronos form holding the power of Deneb, the Imagin who travels with Yuto Sakurai.
Less mobile than Altair Form, but with greater attack and defense.
00b00f614e:
Zeronos's powered-up form, but each transformation consumes Yuto Sakurai's memories.
Its weapon is the Denebick Buster, which the Imagin Deneb becomes.
59c6ecad20:
The future Den-O, transformed by Kotaro Nogami, Ryotaro Nogami's grandson.
He fights with his contracted Imagin, Teddy.
9fbf5735c9:
A combat system developed 22 years ago, refined and completed by the "Wonderful Blue Sky Society".
Worn by Keisuke Nago, a skilled bounty hunter.
4ed589bdcd:
The IXA System's powered-up form, with the IXA Engine pushed to its maximum.
It fights with the IXA Riser.
4a673b34e2:
An anti-Fangire combat system developed 22 years ago.
Back then it fought in this Save Mode; today it shifts to Burst Mode instantly.
041432abfc:
The Fangire's strongest armor, also called the "Kiva of Darkness".
In the present, Wataru Kurenai's brother Taiga Nobori obtained it and transforms.
8bce3edf05:
Daiki Kaito, a treasure hunter after the treasures of every world, transforms.
With the Diendriver he can summon various Riders.
122e017def:
Kuuga evolved further, transformed by Yusuke Onodera.
His whole body is wrapped in powerful electrical energy.
8053a06a7f:
Ryu Terui, a Futo police detective, transforms. He hunts the killer of his parents and sister.
He can become Bike Form, a high-speed form that turns himself into a bike.
9389273ef6:
Accel's powered-up form, from the Accel Memory fitted with the Gaia Memory Upgrade Adapter.
It can move freely through the air.
5aa9ac62f7:
Accel's high-speed form from the Trial Memory.
It moves at the speed of sound for 10 seconds and uses Machine Gun Spike, a barrage of kicks.
528d211e51:
Katsumi Daido of the mercenary unit NEVER transforms with the Eternal Memory and Lost Driver.
He can shut down Gaia Memories older than the T2.
c52acb409e:
Sokichi Narumi, Shotaro Hidari's mentor, transforms with the Skull Memory and Lost Driver.
He excels at gunfights with the Skull Magnum.
11d29c8bbc:
Akira Date, a fighting doctor, transforms with the Birth Driver. Using Cell Medals, he attaches Birth CLAWs all over his body.
Later the Birth Driver passes to Shintaro Goto.
465c63126a:
Birth wearing every Birth CLAW.
It's strong in battle, but uses that many more Cell Medals.
541d7e49a0:
Ryusei Sakuta transforms with the Meteor Driver and Meteor Switch.
He fights with his own martial arts and punches launched from the Meteor Galaxy.
3661c2d0b5:
Meteor's powered-up form from the Meteor Storm Switch.
He excels at staff fighting with the Meteor Storm Shaft.
32430b2d75:
Kosuke Nito, an archaeology student, transforms with the Beast Driver: an ancient wizard.
He summons four kinds of mantles on his right shoulder, each casting its own magic.
7cf3075992:
Beast's powered-up form from the Hyper Ring.
He attacks with the Mirage Magnum and the Fringe Slingers on both arms.
d49f779d24:
Kaito Kumon, leader of Team Baron, becomes this Armored Rider.
Banana Arms is Baron's basic form, wiping out enemies with the giant spear Banaspear.
a288c39cb4:
Baron's special form from the Mango Lockseed.
He wields the Mango Punisher, which damages even tough enemies.
c508a1041a:
Baron's evolved form, transformed by Kaito Kumon with the Genesis Driver.
Like the other Genesis Riders, he corners enemies with the Sonic Arrow.
513c6856c4:
Mitsuzane Kureshima becomes this Armored Rider.
Budou Arms is Ryugen's basic form, keeping its distance with the Budou Ryuhou.
8ae7dc6f23:
Takatora Kureshima transforms with the Genesis Driver and Melon Energy Lockseed: a new generation of Armored Rider.
His Sonic Arrow handles both long and close range.
c8077b8120:
Freelance photographer Go Shijima transforms with the Mach Driver Honoh and Signal Bikes.
He fights with Signal Koukan, which gives his Zenrin Shooter special powers.
5b2c0b6172:
Mach's powered-up form from Shift Dead Heat.
Like Drive's Type Dead Heat, it has explosive power but risks going berserk.
f2ae6c3918:
Chase transformed with the Mach Driver Honoh and a Signal Bike.
Torn between human and Roidmude, he realizes saving humans is his instinct and resolves to start over.
8e7f8d466c:
A gifted, athletic student at Johoku University.
Shocker targeted him for it and made him a grasshopper cyborg.
Escaping just before brainwashing, he became Kamen Rider to fight for human freedom.
3fe541fb97:
Takeshi Hongo, a Johoku University scientist, made a grasshopper cyborg by Shocker.
Saved before brainwashing by his mentor Dr. Midorikawa, he shakes off a cyborg's sorrow to fight Shocker for humanity.
7b130f69fb:
Photographer Hayato Ichimonji, a judo and karate master, transforms.
Remodeled by Shocker to kill Hongo, he was saved by him, became Kamen Rider 2 and guards Japan in his place.
8914464437:
Shiro Kazami: the Rider of power and technique, heir to No. 1's skill and No. 2's power.
Destron killed his family and left him dying; remodeled by No. 1 and No. 2, he was reborn as V3.
eda5563bf7:
Joji Yuki, a former Destron scientist, fights with a right-arm attachment and power suit.
Nearly executed by Marshal Armor and losing his arm, he swore revenge, then turned to justice, fighting Destron with V3.
f17ae490de:
Keisuke Jin transforms: the Kaizorg, a cyborg for deep-sea development, fighting with the shape-shifting Ridol.
Attacked by GOD with his father, he was reborn as Kamen Rider X by his dying father's surgery.
03815a1277:
Amazon (Daisuke Yamamoto), lost in the Amazon after a plane crash as a baby, transforms.
Given the Gigi Armlet by the Inca elder Bago, he became Amazon Rider, fighting Gedon and the Garanda Empire with wild skills.
